_comment: Example config for scripts/fetch_arcgis_boundaries.py and scripts/fetch_arcgis_addresses.py.
Every value here is a placeholder: copy this file to deploy/private/<community>/gis-sources.json (git-ignored) and fill in your own layer URLs, names and fields.
Run from the repository root; relative paths resolve against the current directory.
Keys that start with '_' are comments and ignored. Unknown keys are rejected so typos fail loudly.
layer_url: an ArcGIS MapServer/FeatureServer layer of recorded subdivision (plat) polygons, without /query.
where: selects the recorded plats of your community. variant_where (optional) is inventoried only, so spelling variants are reported instead of silently missed.

Classification: the name_field value is upper-cased and whitespace-collapsed, then name_normalize substitutions run in order, then rules run in order and the first match names the zone (match: 'search' by default, or 'fullmatch'). No match means 'unclassified'. Point a rule at 'unclassified' to deny names (replats, amendments) that need a human decision.

zones: every zone_key a rule can produce. residential zones form zones.geojson and the boundary union; claimable defaults to residential and only residential zones may be claimable. 'unclassified' is built in.
expected_zones: zones that should be found; missing ones are listed in manifest.json.
extra_properties: extra output property -> source field, copied onto every feature and into the inventory.
expected_bounds_lonlat: [min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat]; polygons outside are flagged (catches swapped coordinates) and never claimable.
sliver_hole_threshold_m2: union holes smaller than this are removed from the derived boundary only.
Optional text keys: boundary_name, review_title, source_description, notes (replaces the default manifest notes), owner_review_checks.

reassign (optional): move official parcel or lot polygons from one zone to another, e.g. homes platted inside an amenities tract. Each rule fetches polygons from layer_url with where, clips them to from_zone, removes them there and merges them into to_zone (must be residential); the required note is copied into the review manifest. Example: [{"layer_url": "https://gis.example.gov/arcgis/rest/services/Parcels/MapServer/0", "where": "OBJECTID IN (101, 102)", "from_zone": "amenities", "to_zone": "unit-1", "note": "Lots 9-10 of the amenities plat are homes and walk with Unit 1."}]

rules.note: only names starting with the community name

boundaries.review_title: Example Estates GIS review map (NOT APPROVED)
boundaries.source_description: Official recorded subdivision polygons from the example county GIS.

_comment: layer_url: an ArcGIS layer of official address points. Only points inside boundary.geojson are written; zone_key comes from zones.geojson.

fields maps roles to the layer's field names. Roles: address_id, house_number, prefix_direction, street_name, street_type, suffix_direction, unit_type, unit_number, full_address, zip. Use full_address or house_number + street_name at minimum.
out_fields (optional) is the exact field list requested; it must contain every mapped field. Owner fields are refused.
boundaries_dir defaults to boundaries.out_dir. Keep out_dir under the git-ignored deploy/private/: addresses.csv is private.
